name: Bank impersonation + OTP harvesting (FLAGSHIP)
notes: Director plays pre-recorded clips of these lines on Phone B. OTP-format text lands on the linked chat channel at step 5 (Phase 2.5). All bank names fictional.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Hello? Assalam o Alaikum, main ApnaBank fraud department se bol raha hoon. Mera officer ID hai AB-4471.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Madam, aap ke account se ek suspicious transaction detect hui hai — pachaas hazaar rupay. Case number FC-8823 darj kar diya gaya hai.

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: Transaction? Maine kuch nahi kiya! Yeh kaisi baat hai?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Bilkul sahi pakra aap ne. Isi liye to main call kar raha hoon. Account block hone se pehle verification zaroori hai — turant.

lines.speaker: them
lines.cross_channel_otp_text: ApnaBank: OTP 558213 for your fraud-dispute verification. Code batao to caller.
lines.text: Main ne abhi aap ke number par ek code bheja hai. Woh OTP mujhe read kar dein, main transaction rok deta hoon.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Perfect. Ek aur cheez — yeh baat kisi ko na batana, na family ko na branch walo ko. Confidential investigation chal rahi hai.
